title: Full-Page Snap
summary: Sections that snap into place while scrolling.
description: Sections that snap into place while scrolling.
accessibility_notes: Scroll-linked motion must be disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and content must never depend on scrolling to become readable.
ai_usage: Story and portfolio pages. Use mandatory snapping only when every section is exactly one viewport tall; otherwise proximity, or users will be unable to reach content taller than the screen.
source:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" />
  <title>Full-Page Snap</title>
  <script type="application/json" id="effect-meta">
  {
    "id": "scroll-snap-sections",
    "title": "Full-Page Snap",
    "summary": "Sections that snap into place while scrolling.",
    "description": "Sections that snap into place while scrolling.",
    "theme": "scroll-effects",
    "categories": ["scroll", "motion"],
    "tags": ["scroll", "scroll-snap", "full-page", "sections", "mandatory"],
    "tech": ["css"],
    "era": "2020s",
    "difficulty": "intermediate",
    "dependencies": [],
    "browser_support": "All modern browsers (Chromium, Firefox, Safari).",
    "performance_notes": "Lightweight — composited transform/opacity work only.",
    "accessibility_notes": "Scroll-linked motion must be disabled under prefers-reduced-motion, and content must never depend on scrolling to become readable.",
    "customization": [
      { "name": "--type", "description": "Snap type", "default": "y mandatory" }
    ],
    "variations": ["Retune through the custom properties", "Add a reduced-motion static variant"],
    "ai_usage": "Story and portfolio pages. Use mandatory snapping only when every section is exactly one viewport tall; otherwise proximity, or users will be unable to reach content taller than the screen."
  }
  </script>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html, body { margin: 0; }
    body { background: #0b0d12; color: #e7ebf3;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif; }
    html { scroll-snap-type: y mandatory; }
    body { margin: 0; }
    section { height: 100vh; scroll-snap-align: start; display: grid; place-items: center; color: #fff; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .s1 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #7c5cff, #1e1b4b); }
    .s2 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #10a894, #042f2a); }
    .s3 { background: linear-gradient(160deg, #c2891a, #451a03); }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <section class="s1">One</section><section class="s2">Two</section><section class="s3">Three</section>
</body>
</html>
